title: 설령 첫겨울
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: gameplay concept screenshot for a 2D pixel-art game planning article; opaque landscape 16:9, 1536x864.
Primary request: Show a playable colony simulation, four residents surviving their first winter in a small snowy village in Eoul, a fictional world inspired by Korean folklore.
Scene/backdrop: top-down overhead pixel art, hanok rooms with cutaway roofs. A common furnace glows amber beside sleeping mats; a kitchen, stacked rice sacks in a store room, a woodpile, an outdoor chopping block and snowy yard.
Subject: Four small readable hanbok citizen sprites each doing a different activity: hauling a log, cooking rice, chopping wood, resting on a mat. One resident is selected with a fine square selection border. Nobody is an action hero.
Composition/framing: Full-screen working game interface. World scene occupies the left 75 percent. Right narrow management panel has exactly four citizen rows, each row a portrait plus small hunger, warmth and rest icons and their colored meter bars. Bottom schedule editor shows four resident rows divided into three clear colored segments labeled WORK, EAT, REST. Selected resident work priorities appear as small cook, haul, chop icons numbered 1, 2, 3. Top HUD has simple food and wood counters, DAY 4, and an approaching snowstorm forecast icon.
Style/medium: consistent crisp visible square pixels, refined 16-bit strategy game sprite art, orthographic overhead view with slight front-facing building walls; compact legible pixel UI. No antialiasing-painted objects, no painterly texture.
Lighting/mood: warm room heat overlay in amber, cold blue overlay outdoors, winter dusk atmosphere. Keep floors and activity silhouettes readable.
Text (verbatim): DAY 4, WORK, EAT, REST. Use minimal tiny numbers and icons elsewhere.
Constraints: Colony residents, assignment priorities, needs and work schedules must read immediately. No direct-controlled hero, no combat, no route automation belts, no cards, no overworld branching map, no title poster or giant headline. No logos or watermark.

title: 장승 모의전
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: gameplay concept screenshot for a 2D pixel-art game planning article; opaque landscape 16:9, 1536x864.
Primary request: Show the preparation phase of an economy autobattler in a Korean folklore-inspired fictional village. Friendly wooden jangseung puppet guardians made by artisans are being bought, placed and merged before a harmless staged mock duel.
Scene/backdrop: bright daytime Korean courtyard arena, tiled-roof walls, wooden banners and peach blossoms, warm stone paving.
Subject: Distinct carved wooden guardian puppets with expressive jangseung faces, three clearly different roles: stout shield guardian, round drum guardian, and slender bow guardian.
Composition/framing: Full-screen actual game-like UI. Central board clearly contains TWO mirrored formations separated by a generous central space: player formation LEFT is exactly six fixed square positions, in two rows and three columns; opponent formation RIGHT is exactly six fixed square positions, also two rows and three columns. Place a few distinct guardians on each side with some empty positions remaining. Beneath player formation is a separate five-slot bench. A bright mouse-cursor hand is dragging one shield guardian from bench toward an empty left-side formation square, connected only by a short pale drag arc. Bottom shop strip has exactly three rectangular unit offers with guardian sprites and coin prices 2, 3, 4, plus a circular refresh icon. Offers look like shop shelves, not playing cards. A small repeated guardian 2/3 merge-progress indicator near bench. Top HUD displays coin icon 18, interest +1, ROUND 3. A prominent button at bottom right says READY.
Style/medium: crisp visible square 16-bit pixels throughout, charming handcrafted Korean wood textures expressed in pixel clusters, readable units, thick functional UI borders. Mostly top-down with shallow front view, no cinematic perspective.
Lighting/mood: clear daylight, inviting competitive toy tournament, readable formation squares.
Text (verbatim): ROUND 3, 18, +1, 2, 3, 4, READY.
Constraints: Buying, saving interest, merging and formation positioning before automatic battle are the focus. No spell cards, no card hand, no deckbuilding, no inventory packing puzzle, no manual action combat, no character portraits filling screen, no game logo or watermark. Show genuine gameplay HUD, not a poster.
